text:
eve (oncall): quick postmortem follow-up: recurring pattern of autoscaler backfill + KV cold starts. last incident: p99 ~1800ms for ~35m, throughput -30%. need a plan: SLO strategy + owners.

tom (infra): agree. short-term: add startup_grace to avoid counting node join tail in SLO. i'll own infra change (ETA 24h).

ray (serving): serving fixes: KV pre-warm + soft batch caps + fallback routing. i'll take implementation + alerts (ETA 72h).

gina (product): customers affected: a few enterprise nightly batch jobs. product wants opt-in throughput SLO for burst windows and comms template. i'll own comms (ETA 36h).

alert-bot: Incident INC-2026-199 recorded: autoscaler backfill correlated with KV misses.

eve (oncall): draft SLO snippet to discuss:
```yaml
service: inference-api
slo:
  steady_p99_ms: 500
  burst_throughput_p95_rps: 130
  burst_window: 10m
error_budget:
  allow_dynamic_shift: true
  max_shift: 0.02
```

eve (oncall): action items:
- tom (infra): implement startup_grace + tagging (due 24h)
- ray (serving): pre-warm + batch cap + add alerts (due 72h)
- gina (product): draft customer note & SLA impact (due 36h)
- eve (oncall): open SLO config PR & dashboards (due 12h)

tom (infra): added log tag=autoscaler_join to pipeline. will follow up with PR.

ray (serving): staging pre-warm passing; canary scheduled for 6h.

gina (product): will coordinate legal for SLA wording and prepare short FAQ.

eve (oncall): scheduling decision sync in 3 days to decide opt-in rollout vs global change. calendar: https://cal.link/3day-burst-slo. closing thread - will post PR links here. :white_check_mark:
